component.name: ChatGPT (Unofficial Flatpak)
component.summary: Independent packaging of OpenAI's native desktop application

description.p: Independent Flatpak packaging for OpenAI's native ChatGPT Linux application, including Chat, Work, and Codex. This packaging is not affiliated with or endorsed by OpenAI.

The proprietary application is downloaded directly from OpenAI during installation. A ChatGPT account and an internet connection are required. Availability of features depends on your account and OpenAI's service.
